{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# First, filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Then deduplicate: keep the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print the result
print(num_patients)"}
